The mythical Greek hero (Reg Park) rescues a maiden left at the mercy of a beast and goes on to save his son from the sexist queen of lost Atlantis (Fay Spain).
programme.title: Hercules and the Captive Women

programme.desc: A U-boat Nazi (Eric Portman) and his comrades raid a Canadian outpost, hijack a seaplane and kill to reach the United States.
programme.title: 49th Parallel

programme.desc: A killer of Detroit clergy confesses to a priest (Donald Sutherland), who turns sleuth because he cannot tell the police.
programme.title: The Rosary Murders

programme.desc: An owner of an escort service hatches some enterprising schemes to turn business around during World War II.
programme.title: Miss London Ltd.

programme.desc: William Wyler's Oscar-winning classic about the tensions faced by a family of hard-working Brits in war-torn England.
programme.title: Mrs. Miniver

programme.desc: A couple (Ron Howard, Cindy Williams) and their high-school friends do their own things on four mid-1960s New Year's Eves.
programme.title: More American Graffiti

programme.desc: President Grant helps a cavalry major (Dale Robertson) condemned for helping Dakota Chief Sitting Bull (J. Carrol Naish).
programme.title: Sitting Bull

programme.desc: A Quaker (Gail Russell) and her family reform a wounded outlaw (John Wayne) who has a killer on his trail.
programme.title: Angel and the Badman

programme.desc: A Greek sponge diver (Robert Wagner) in Florida loves the daughter (Terry Moore) of a rival family of Key West sponge hookers.
programme.title: Beneath the 12-Mile Reef

programme.desc: A British captain (Kenneth More) uses an old train to get a Hindu prince, his governess (Lauren Bacall) and others out of a besieged citadel.
programme.title: Northwest Frontier

programme.desc: A murdered gangster makes a deal with the devil, agreeing to take over and corrupt a crusading judge's identity in return for avenging his murder.
programme.title: Angel on My Shoulder

programme.desc: A corporate climber (Jack Lemmon), whose boss (Fred MacMurray) and others use his apartment for hanky-panky, aids a young woman (Shirley MacLaine).
programme.title: The Apartment

programme.desc: Incompatible friends (Bob Hope, Lucille Ball), taken for granted by their spouses, fall in love after having to spend time alone together.
programme.title: The Facts of Life

programme.desc: A New York dancer (Fred Astaire) grooms a chorus girl (Judy Garland) to be his new partner, falling in love along the way.
programme.title: Easter Parade

programme.desc: A French diplomat (Jean-Pierre Aumont) falls for a recent graduate (Ginger Rogers) of a Paris school for pickpockets.
programme.title: Heartbeat

programme.desc: A gruff neighbor (Lee Marvin) and a newspaper editor (Gary Merrill) help a teenage farmer (Brandon de Wilde) grow up in circa-1910 Missouri.
programme.title: The Missouri Traveler

programme.desc: The Caped Crusader (Michael Keaton) saves dismal Gotham City and gorgeous Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger) from the freaky Joker (Jack Nicholson).
programme.title: Batman

programme.desc: Dorothy tries to save her dog from a storm and eases on down the road to see the Wiz with Tin Man, Scarecrow and Cowardly Lion.
programme.title: The Wiz

programme.desc: A man (Robert Woods) seeks revenge against the bandit (Dean Stratford) who killed his younger brother during a massacre.
programme.title: Savage Guns

programme.desc: Two high-living adventurers settle in the world of fast cars, beautiful women and ruthless criminals.
programme.title: Mission: Monte Carlo

programme.desc: Ersatz kryptonite laced with tobacco tar splits Superman (Christopher Reeve) in two: good Clark Kent and bad Man of Steel.
programme.title: Superman III

programme.desc: An Illinois widow (Olivia de Havilland) helps a Southern widower (Alan Ladd) traveling with his dog and mute son after the Civil War.
programme.title: The Proud Rebel

programme.desc: Groucho, Chico, Harpo and Zeppo take advantage of hotel guests during the Florida land boom.
programme.title: The Cocoanuts

programme.desc: Songwriter Jerome Kern (Robert Walker) recalls his career on the opening night of his Show Boat, December 1927.
programme.title: Till the Clouds Roll By

programme.desc: A one-eyed soothsayer (June Carter Cash) leads a Georgia sheriff (Johnny Cash) to a big shot (Andy Griffith) who crossed the wrong county line.
programme.title: Murder in Coweta County

programme.desc: Two rival radio producers race to get an audience-participation program off the ground and over the airwaves.
programme.title: People Are Funny

programme.desc: Love blooms between a sympathetic attorney and the comely shoplifter he has taken home for the Christmas holiday.
programme.title: Remember the Night

programme.desc: A Manhattan bandleader (James Cagney) and his wife (Evelyn Daw) cannot be married, according to his Hollywood contract.
programme.title: Something to Sing About

programme.desc: The history of 19th-century Western expansion, as seen through the lives of three generations of a pioneer family.
programme.title: How the West Was Won

programme.desc: The first manned flight to Mars is a flop, so a space official (Hal Holbrook) fakes it Hollywood-style for the public.
programme.title: Capricorn One

programme.desc: An electrician (Richard Hatch), a TV newswoman (Kay Lenz) and a mad scientist enter a dimension ruled by a warlord (John Saxon).
programme.title: Prisoners of the Lost Universe

programme.desc: A reformed outlaw's (Elvis Presley) old gang tries to frame him for the theft of a jeweled Mexican cannon.
programme.title: Charro!

programme.desc: Adm. Kirk (William Shatner), Mr. Spock (Leonard Nimoy), Dr. McCoy (DeForest Kelley) and crew embark in the overhauled Enterprise to find an intelligent entity called VGER.
programme.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture

programme.desc: An oilman (Albert Dekker) and a cowboy (John Wayne) become boom-town rivals for a schoolmarm (Martha Scott) and Oklahoma oil.
programme.title: War of the Wildcats

programme.desc: Mistaken identity spurs a foreign spy (James Mason) to pursue an innocent New Yorker (Cary Grant), all the way to Mount Rushmore.
programme.title: North by Northwest

programme.desc: The more Budapest co-workers (Margaret Sullavan, James Stewart) fight, the more they fall in love as secret pen pals.
programme.title: The Shop Around the Corner
